{{Top|leg}}
'''Weavers''' held an important position within [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] society. They worked with the wool of the [[tomuon]] to create [[tomuon cloth]] which was in high demand among communities in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The techniques used by the weavers were closely guarded secrets and wars had been fought on [[Askaj]] over high-skilled weavers. Exceptionally talented weavers were referred to as a [[loommaster]] or loommistress.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
